sentences.text:
Order 
1. This is third application under Section 439 of Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

The applicant is implicated in connection with Crime No.17/2021 registered at Police Station Crime Branch, District Indore (MP) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B of the IPC and Sections 25 and 27 of Arms Act.

entities.text: Police Station Crime Branch, District Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant is in custody since 27.06.2021.
2. First application of the applicant bearing M.Cr.C. No.10239/2022 was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 15.06.2022.

Second application of the applicant bearing M.Cr.C. No.55929 of 2023 was disposed off vide order dated 22.12.2023 with a direction to the trial Court to expedite the trial and to make endeavour for finally concluding the same at an early stage.

The learned counsel for the applicant submits that the case is at the stage of final hearing and final arguments of one of the accused Devendra have already been heard and that of the applicant and another co-accused only are to be heard.

Nothing further is required to be done in the matter,
hence trial Court may be directed to conclude the proceedings at the earliest.
4.

Considering the totality of the circumstances of the case, it is directed that the trial Court shall hear the arguments of the parties and shall finally decide the trial itself within a period of sixty days Azaz vs State Of Madhya Pradesh on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69663198/
1 from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order.

sentences.text: No unnecessary adjournment be granted to the parties to advance their arguments.
5. With the aforesaid direction, the application stands disposed off.
